title: 042 - CSV Column Count
prompt: Fix the bug so the program count the CSV columns in the sample row and print 3 and prints exactly `3`. Keep the sample data and do not add extra output.
brokenCode:

  left_index = 0
  right_index = 0
  while left_index < left.length && right_index < right.length
    if left[left_index] >= right[right_index]

solutionCode:
def csv_column_count(left, right)
  merged = []
  left_index = 0
  right_index = 0
  while left_index < left.length && right_index < right.length
    if left[left_index] <= right[right_index]
      merged << left[left_index]
      left_index += 1
    else
      merged << right[right_index]
      right_index += 1
    end
  end
  merged.concat(left[left_index..] || []).concat(right[right_index..] || []).join(",")
end
hint: The split logic assumes the wrong separator pattern.
explanation: The broken code splits on the wrong text, so the row is not separated correctly. Splitting on commas fixes the count.
